description: Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, commercial invoice drafts and packing lists for global trade. Calculate profit, shipment volume and indicative currency conversions; build road, sea or air transport plans and task lists with suggested reminder dates. Discover approved public B2B and logistics listing summaries. Turkish and English supported. Documents and plans are unsaved drafts. No actual notifications, bookings, messaging, account synchronization or HS/GTIP search.

defaultPrompt: Calculate a selling price and profit with USD 6,500 product cost, USD 1,200 logistics, USD 300 other costs and 20% markup.
Draft a sea transport plan: Vietnam to Canada, 48 packages, 24.5 cubic metres, 8,200 kg.
Help me prepare a proforma invoice, packing list and export task plan. Ask for missing details and suggest reminder dates.
